newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF says buys 24,000 tonnes of oilseeds.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF says buys 24,000 tonnes of oilseeds.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperative Federation (NLCF) said on Tuesday it bought a total of 24,000 tonnes of oilseeds in tenders.
An official with the federation said the NLCF bought 14,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal and 10,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal.
The federation also passed on tenders for another 15,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal and 6,500 tonnes of cottonseed meal due to high offer prices, he said.
He said the federation was unable to buy 8,000 tonnes of grain screening pellet as there were no offers.
The passed tenders would be re-invited on Friday, the official said.
The premium for port rotation was set at $1.5 a tonne.
